approved: Protecting Australia’s Prime Agricultural Land Bill 2026

Moved the Protecting Australia's Prime Agricultural Land Bill 2026 for second reading, arguing that prime agricultural land should be reserved for agriculture to protect food security. The bill would restrict residential, mining, industrial and other non-agricultural uses, prevent expansion of existing non-agricultural use and require agricultural use to resume when such use ends.
